description:
Zscaler (NASDAQ: ZS) accelerates digital transformation so customers can be more agile, efficient, resilient, and secure. The Zscaler Zero Trust Exchange platform protects thousands of customers from cyberattacks and data loss by securely connecting users, devices, and applications in any location. Distributed across 200+ public data centers globally and thousands of private sites at the edge, the SASE-based Zero Trust Exchange is the world’s largest in-line cloud security platform.

We believe the future of work is Human + AI and are building an AI-native enterprise where human potential is amplified by machine intelligence to solve the world’s hardest security challenges. Driven by deep customer obsession, we are committed to the mission, outcome, and to each other. We bring these commitments to life through three core behaviors: ownership and collaboration, trust through outcomes and impact, and a challenge culture with ongoing feedback. Ready to make an impact at the company pioneering security transformation in the AI era? Join us at Zscaler.

Role

We are looking for a Senior Regional Sales Operations Manager to join our team and support the AMS Majors Sales team. This is a Remote role, reporting to the Senior Director of Sales Operations in the Go-to-Market Operations team. You will join a group of professionals passionate about delighting customers and sharing their expertise to drive a secure, cloud-enabled digital future by partnering with cross-functional teams to demonstrate the power and agility of cloud transformation. In doing so, you will help further cement Zscaler’s position as the world leader in cloud security.

What you’ll do (Role Expectations)

  • Partner with Sales leaders to build and execute strategies to achieve overall business objectives and Annual Operating Plan
  • Lead and coordinate Americas sales GTM planning, including territory planning, quota setting, and headcount management, aligned with global initiatives
  • Drive operational cadence, forecasting, pipeline management, and business insights programs
  • Deliver data-driven insights to Sales Leadership, identifying and implementing improvements in sales processes and procedures to drive sales productivity
  • Act as a subject matter expert, collaborating with cross-functional teams to drive efficiency and lead global programs for the Americas

Who You Are (Success Profile)

  • You act like an owner, allowing your passion for the mission to fuel your bias for action as you adapt seamlessly between high-level strategy and hands-on execution.
  • You are a high-trust collaborator who is ambitious for the team, embracing a challenge culture by giving and receiving feedback with candor and respect.
  • You are a pragmatic builder obsessed with creating, iterating, and shipping, balancing the drive for operational excellence with the need to deliver value quickly.
  • You are data-driven, consistently using analytics to find the truth, measure what matters, and guide informed business decisions.
  • You think at scale by connecting your day-to-day work to the larger company mission, building solutions and processes designed to support a high-growth, global organization.

What We’re Looking for (Minimum Qualifications)

  • Demonstrated curiosity and active exploration of AI tools, with a proven history of integrating new technologies to enhance daily workflows and augment problem-solving
  • 8+ years of relevant Sales Operations experience
  • Strong understanding and experience in GTM strategies, annual fiscal planning, data analysis/modelling and reporting to drive business decisions
  • Proven ability to manage multiple concurrent projects independently in a fast-paced environment and deliver high-quality results
  • Bachelor’s degree or relevant work experience
  • Expertise with Microsoft Office/Google suite applications, Tableau/Snowflake Streamline, and Salesforce

What Will Make You Stand Out (Preferred Qualifications)

  • Demonstrate strong AI fluency by leveraging coding assistants, LLMs, and Generative AI tools to accelerate troubleshooting, solution design, automation, and customer problem-solving, while applying sound technical judgment to validate outputs
  • Experience in the high-growth B2B Software/SaaS industry, preferably within cybersecurity
  • Strong collaboration and stakeholder management skills with a proven ability to influence stakeholders
  • MBA or equivalent advanced degree

Zscaler’s salary ranges are benchmarked and are determined by role and level. The range displayed on each job posting reflects the minimum and maximum target for new hire salaries for the position across all US locations and could be higher or lower based on a multitude of factors, including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.

The base salary range listed for this full-time position excludes commission/ bonus/ equity (if applicable) + benefits.

Base Pay Range
$150,500—$215,000 USD

We foster an inclusive environment that values all backgrounds and perspectives, emphasizing collaboration and belonging. Join us in our mission to make doing business seamless and secure.
